lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in a multi-tier grid, specifically in three primary horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits and aligned between the longitudinal ridges.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs to form distinct anchor points, most prominent in the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel linear features run horizontally across the upper and middle flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light upper surfaces to shadowed lower recesses.

other_distinctive_markers: A remora is visible as a low-luminance elongated silhouette positioned ventrally, posterior to the right pectoral fin.
